prior_attempt.accounting: Cumulative through the completed v2 run: its cumulative rated cost and its settled safety amount plus the reconciled v1 safety amount. Not an invoice total.

pricing_source.boundary: Standard Global synchronous requests, short context. Retail-rate calculated cost, not reconciled invoice, discounts, tax, or procurement budget. Batching here means merging work into one normal request, not the Azure Batch API.

authorization.execution: User approved step 3, supplied this replacement Azure deployment, and selected eight new-source holdout projects. Execution is limited to this reviewed 270-call campaign.
authorization.inputs: Only the 27 normalized public-source briefs in this pinned catalog, their requirement annotations and exclusions, and the pinned scoping template. The corpus includes two labeled job postings and one labeled sample template; neither represents an issued RFP.
authorization.tools: None. No source fetch, private data, client contact, deployment, or full-project execution.
authorization.retries: None. Stop after transport, telemetry, output-cap, or identity failure; preserve uncertain reservations.
authorization.quality: Automatic contract checks are necessary but not sufficient. Free-text drafts require human review before quality-preserving optimization can be promoted.
authorization.holdout: All six previously examined projects are development/training sources in this revision. Eight of the 21 new sources are held out; all operations and repetitions stay with their project. Historical catalogs and measured records remain unchanged.

budget_approval.basis: User authorized paid generation and said: Don't stop, you have an unlimited budget. This revision instead authorizes only the fixed 270-call workload under a finite ceiling covering all worst-case safety reservations. Prior Azure safety accounting is included; no automatic retry, restart, or additional campaign is authorized.
